name: Shenzhen SED Industry Co., Ltd.
summary: Shenzhen SED Industry Co., Ltd. provides digital and information, and industrial services in China. The company offers cloud computing and storage, data innovation, and digital government and industry digitization services. It also provides high-tech industry services, such as cleanroom services, digital heating, and new energy services. In addition, the company offers housing rental; smart lighting system integration; building decoration, renovation, and other construction industries; software and information technology services; logistic services; as well as manufacturing electronic product. Shenzhen SED Industry Co., Ltd. was founded in 1993 and is based in Shenzhen, China.
